details.youth_clubs: Kyunghee FC U12 (경희FC U12, 2017-2018), Chungnam Asan FC U15 (충남아산FC U15, 2019-2020), Cheonan FMC FC U15 (천안 FMC FC U15, 2021), Gangwon FC U18 (강릉제일고등학교, 2022-2024)
details.further_information: 2024 K League 1 Team of the Year 2024 K League 1 Rookie of the Season Yang is the first high school professional player in K League 1 history by signing a contract on June 17, 2024. Youngest goalscorer in the history of K League 1. Youngest goalscorer in the history of Gangwon FC (17 years 10 months 23 days). Youngest player in the history of Gangwon FC to debut (17 years 10 months 15 days) until team mate Kim Hyeong-jin broke the record a few months later. Youngest player in K League history to score two goal participations in two consecutive matches. Youngest player in K League history to be awarded Player of the Month. First semi-pro player in K League history to be awarded Young Player of the Month. First semi-pro player in K League history to win consecutive awards. First player in K League history to be awarded Young Player of the Month four times in a row (previous record was two times in a row). First player in K League history to be awarded Young Player of the Month five times.
